div.head: Af 13
div.ab: Gif mon oþerne æt gemænan weorce offealle ungewealdes, agife mon ðam magum ðæt triow, ⁊ hy hit hæbben ær XXX nihta of ðæm lande don, oþþe him fó to se þe þone wudu age.
Gif mon oðerne æt gemænan weorce óffelle ungewealdes, agife mon þam mægum þæt treow, ⁊ hi hit hæbben ær XXX nihta of þam lande, oððe him fó se to se ðe ðone wudu age.
Si quis alium in communi opere casu deiciat, reddatur lignum parentibus interfecti; et habeant hoc infra triginta dies eductum de terra illa, uel habeat hoc cuius erit nemus.
Gif mon oðerne æt gemænan weorce óffelle ungewealdes, agife mon þam mægum þæt treow, ⁊ hi hit hæbben ær XXX nihta of þam lande, oððe him fó se to se ðe ðone wudu age.

If someone kills another accidentally [by felling a tree on him] while working together, let the tree be given to the kin [of the slain man], and they must take it from the land before 30 nights, or let the owner take it.

If one man kills another unintentionally, [by allowing a tree to fall on him], while they are engaged on a common task, the tree shall be given to the [dead man's] kindred, and they shall remove it within 30 days from the locality. Otherwise, it shall be taken by him who owns the wood.

If at a common task a man unintentionally kills another [by letting a tree fall on him] the tree is to be given to the kinsmen, and they are to have it from that estate within 30 days, or else he who owns the wood is to have the right to it.

Wenn einer den andern unabsichtlich bei gemeinsamer Arbeit [des Holzschlags durch den fallenden Baum] erschlägt, liefere man [der Eigenthümer] den Baum den Verwandten [des Verunglückten] aus; und sie sollen ihn vor 30 Nächten vom Lande [fortgeschafft] haben, widrigenfalls jener, der das Gehölz besitzt, ihn nehmen darf.

If someone unintentionally kills another at shared work [of timber-felling, by the falling tree], let [the owner] hand over the tree to the kinsmen [of the victim]; and they are to have [removed] it from the land within 30 nights, otherwise the one who owns the woodland may take it.
